policy.limits: one owned worker; old space 4096 MiB; step 30s; wall 120s; worker RSS 6GiB; owner RSS 256MiB; window 20min; output 10MiB
policy.isolation: empty child environment; synthetic memory data only; no network, API, .env, DSN, database or UI
policy.order: seeds 23/47/89; ascending M per seed; metadata; each query scan+index verification then 3 fresh index workers
policy.read: same full navigation + page20 offset0; first + warmup + 5 samples; hashing/serialization excluded; no forced GC
policy.admission: per previous job; 1.25 reserve; quadratic preparation; count-batch scaling; linear other growth; <=4GiB/20s read/100s job
policy.scope: static in-memory implementation evidence, not overall product limits or a backend SLA; interactive host
